title: Scaling Empowered Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13002v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter. Website and code at \href{htt

translated_abstract: 赋能度衡量的是智能体主动控制其环境的能力。在本工作中，我们阐明了技能学习与赋能度之间的联系。虽然技能学习并不等于赋能度，但我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的赋能度最大化方法：赋能度对应于从某一状态出发可执行的技能数量，因此最大化赋能度就等价于到达那些能够作为众多技能良好起点的状态。我们的方法适用于任意底层技能学习方法。以往关于赋能度的研究大多局限于表格型设置，而该方法使我们能够在大规模环境中研究赋能度，从而实现理论上已被预测、但经验上难以观测到的赋能度特性（例如收集资源、改造环境、生存等）。实验表明，赋能度最大化能够解锁有趣的涌现特性，例如在 Crafter 环境中建造房屋。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种简单可扩展的赋能度最大化方法——将赋能度视为某状态下可执行技能的数量，引导智能体到达多种技能的良好起点状态——从而首次在大规模环境中实现了理论预测的赋能度涌现特性，如收集资源、改造环境、生存，以及在 Crafter 中建造房屋。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization—treating empowerment as the number of executable skills from a state and guiding agents to states that serve as good starting points for many skills—enabling, for the first time at scale, theoretically-predicted emergent properties of empowerment such as resource gathering, environment modification, survival, and building a house in Crafter.
